facts: Parties: Thornbury Medical Ltd (Buyer), Bellhaven Energy plc (Seller); the Company is Pemberton Logistics plc.
This Agreement is dated 21 May 2027; Closing is scheduled for 23 June 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 24 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 48 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 24 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Galloway Logistics plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
